data.name: Basna
data.description: Basna d.o.o. is a small Swiss-owned, family-run company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Čačak, Serbia, producing charcoal and biochar from wood biomass via pyrolysis. It holds European Biochar Certificate (EBC) certification and is listed as a Puro.earth biochar supplier, with products used primarily as animal feed additive and soil amendment.
